claim: The windowpane test indicates whether gluten development is sufficient to hold gas evenly, by checking if dough can be stretched thin enough to see light through without tearing.

corroboration.rationale: The source page from Fond Kitchen explicitly confirms the claim. It states that the windowpane test checks whether dough forms a thin, translucent membrane without ripping to ensure the gluten network is strong enough to trap gas and give the bread structure.

citations.title: Windowpane Test: How to Do It and Why Dough Fails It | Fond
